logic.bm: Utility Solutions (63% of 2025 sales): utility T&D components — arresters, insulators, connectors, anchors, bushings, enclosures, cutouts, hot-line tools, gas distribution components; grid automation/communications — Aclara smart meters & AMI, Beckwith Electric protective relays, EIG power-quality meters, Systems Control substation control & relay panels/buildings, Meramec instrument transformers, DMC Power substation connectors. Hubbell does NOT manufacture distribution/power transformers; exposure is to the same utility T&D capex cycle (In Front of the Meter). Electrical Solutions: wiring devices, connectors (Burndy), harsh & hazardous, data-center enclosures (PCX), etc.
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.
